response.sql: SELECT t.transreg AS transaction_ref, t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(s.shortintrt) / NULLIF(AVG(AVG(s.shortintrt)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.ordertypedist), 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
